items.title: Applied AI and Data Science Bootcamp
items.longDescription:
# About the Internship Program

The **Applied AI & Data Science Internship Program**, organized by **qubitedge Global Services Pvt. Ltd.**, was conducted from **18 May 2026 to 26 June 2026** with the objective of providing students with practical exposure to emerging technologies and industry-relevant skills.

The program witnessed an overwhelming response, with **250+ students** participating from various engineering colleges and universities across different regions. Throughout the internship, participants engaged in a structured learning journey designed to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and real-world applications.

The internship covered a wide range of advanced topics including **Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Neural Networks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Internet of Things (IoT), Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI Applications, and Project Development Methodologies**.

Participants had access to:

* Live expert-led sessions
* Recorded video lectures
* Comprehensive study notes
* Interactive quizzes and assessments
* Hands-on learning activities
* Industry-oriented mini projects
* Capstone project opportunities
* Mentor-guided project development

The program was designed and delivered by a team of **academicians, industry professionals, researchers, and technology experts**, ensuring that students gained both theoretical understanding and practical insights into modern technologies.

As an extension of the internship, selected participants were given the opportunity to join a **6-Month Advanced Bootcamp Program**, where they continue to receive mentorship, project guidance, advanced technical training, and exposure to industry practices.

The internship successfully created a collaborative learning environment that encouraged innovation, teamwork, problem-solving, and continuous skill development, helping students prepare for future careers in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and emerging technologies.

**Duration:** 18 May 2026 – 26 June 2026

**Participants:** 250+ Students from Multiple Colleges and Universities

**Organized By:** qubitedge Global Services Pvt. Ltd.

**Mode:** Online Live Sessions, Recorded Content, Assessments, and Project-Based Learning

data.title: Our Story
data.subtitle: Built to Bridge the Gap
data.bodyBeforeQuote: qubitedge was founded with a simple but powerful belief.
data.quote: Talent is everywhere, but opportunity is not.
data.bodyAfterQuote:
What began as a mission to equip students with practical, future-ready skills has grown into a full-scale ecosystem supporting learners, startups, and businesses alike.

Founded by Sam Oguri with over 25 years of global experience, qubitedge is proudly headquartered in The Jewel of the East Coast—Visakhapatnam, with a growing network of partners and clients worldwide.

From hands-on workshops and tech services to executive mentoring and startup incubation, our journey is rooted in one core vision: to turn potential into performance—at every stage of growth.

data.title: Meet our Founder
data.name: Sam Oguri
data.bio:
With over 25 years of leadership in EdTech and global services, the Founder and CEO of qubitedge has a proven track record of building high-performing teams, scaling operations, and turning early-stage ventures into market leaders.

As the founding head of Chegg India, he spearheaded the company's growth from a team of 8 to over 850 professionals. His core expertise spans operational strategy, financial leadership, cross-functional execution, and scaling innovation with structure and precision.

At qubitedge, he leads with a singular mission: to empower students with future-ready skills, and to help startups, professionals, and businesses scale smarter—with clarity, purpose, and measurable impact.
